Swain|adc.identity: Durable magic damage battle mage. Ravenous Flock (passive): his ravens collect soul fragments that heal him and permanently increase his max health. Death's Hand (Q) fires several bolts that pass through enemies (the more that hit a target, the more damage it takes), Vision of Empire (W) strikes a faraway area, slowing and revealing, Nevermove (E) sends out a wave that comes back and roots, then can pull rooted champions toward him, and Demonic Ascension (R) transforms him: he drains health from nearby enemies and can cast Demonflare, an explosion that slows.
Swain|adc.playstyle: Bot lane battle mage: he wins drawn-out fights thanks to his ultimate's drain and his growing health. He has no dash: he wins by catching his targets, not by running.
Swain|adc.early_game: Poke with Death's Hand (Q) and Vision of Empire (W). Nevermove (E) punishes an opponent who steps up: root, pull them in, then point-blank Q. Save E to defend against an engage.
Swain|adc.level_1: Nevermove (E) first. After that, max Q first.
Swain|adc.level_2: Death's Hand (Q). Poke and farm; up close, every bolt hits the same target.
Swain|adc.level_3: Vision of Empire (W). Long-range poke, vision and soul fragments on the champions hit.
Swain|adc.level_6: Demonic Ascension: a constant drain around you, then Demonflare. Combo with your support: E → pull → R → Q.
power_spikes: Level 6: your ultimate's drain in 2v2 fights.
First completed item: very tanky in fights.
Swain|adc.lane_plan: Poke with Q and W, and save E for engages or defense. Play for kills with your support: every CC they land lets you hit E and pull. The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) rewards steady farming. Join fights around dragon.
Swain|adc.trading: Short trade: Q + W. All-in: E → pull → Q → R. Give up on it against ADCs who poke you out of range and chase you down (Zeri).
threats: Enemy Grievous Wounds, which weaken your drain.
mistakes: Wasting E and having no defense left.
Casting your ultimate too far from enemies.
Chasing a mobile target with no dash.

matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: She has to come close: root her with E when she dives.
matchup_notes.Jinx: She scales: force early fights with your support.
matchup_notes.Jhin: Save E for his Deadly Flourish: don't step up right after you've been hit.
matchup_notes.Ezreal: He escapes with E: wait until he's used it before casting Nevermove.
matchup_notes.Zeri: She's too mobile for your E: play near your support.

Swain|adc.mid_game: Join fights and win drawn-out fights with your ultimate. Poke with W before objectives.
Swain|adc.late_game: Mage frontline: go in with R, drain and explode, E to root the diver. Your health grows with every soul fragment.
Swain|adc.ahead: Force long fights and take objectives.
Swain|adc.behind: Farm, poke with W and play drawn-out teamfights.
Swain|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win drawn-out fights thanks to your ultimate's drain and your CC.
Swain|adc.final_tip: Root with E, recast to pull the target in, then point-blank Q: that's your best combo.
